name: workspace
description: Visual monorepo browser, script runner, health inspector, and inline editor — embedded in VS Code. Connects to a local SigmaShake (ssg) daemon for Run/Inspect/Edit; degrades to Browse-only when the daemon is unreachable.

sigmashake.workspace.daemonUrl.description: Base URL of the local SigmaShake (ssg) daemon. Run/Inspect/Edit endpoints are reached here; leave empty to force the cloud Browse-only degradation.

sigmashake.workspace.daemonToken.description: Optional X-SigmaShake-Token bearer for the daemon. Required when the daemon was started without --no-auth (the default). Find it at ~/.sigmashake/dashboard.token or via `ssg dashboard token`.

sigmashake.workspace.monorepoRoot.description: Absolute path to the monorepo root the daemon should scan. Defaults to the daemon's own default when blank.
